independent_review.scope: A separate Neal agent checked the dependent slice-efficient transition against the author manuscript, ordered GEM gaps, blocked Beta/slice law, tail stopping, log-domain sticks, projection targets, numerical errors, and CLI output mapping; no material defect reported. corrections.description: An initial Boolean-label validation fixture had been promoted to Int by Julia before reaching the API. Explicit Any element type fixed the fixture; no transition change was needed.
Initializer copies supplied RNGs; canonical marginal diagnostic reuses the shared stable EPPF. No fixed truncation or arbitrary statistical cap added.

limits: Implemented for fixed positive DP strength and GaussianLocation with known observation variance and a Normal base.
No concentration hyperprior update, PYP slice sampler, nonconjugate atom updater, split-merge or tempering exposed by this entry point.
Main log_target is a canonical marginal projection; ordered_log_target integrates sticks,slices andempty parameters. Neither is the full augmented-state density.
Tiny three-observation posterior frequency checks and numerical conditional tests do not assess general mixing or comparative speed.
Unrepresentable random variates or residual arithmetic abort explicitly rather than silently truncating.
Long-run compute and memory cost grow with the dynamically required prefix; no performance benchmark is claimed.
